reviews.text:
We have taken both our dogs to Great Northwest Animal Hospital for the last six years. Our dogs have received excellent care from all the doctors and technicians and I have had nothing but positive interactions from all of the staff as well.

What finally prompted me to write a review after six years was we recently had to say goodbye to our 14 year old dog. We were all treated with so much compassion and kindness by every single person that day. Later, we even received a hand written card by both his regular vet, Dr. Arroyo, and the vet who was in the office and available for a last minute appointment on the day he passed away, Dr. Saunders.

I cannot express my gratitude to all of the staff at Great Northwest Animal Hospital. We will continue to bring our other dog, as well as any future dogs we adopt, here for their care.
The doctor is very knowledgeable and clear, helped us through and through with next steps to take. my dog has a fractured/broken ankle bone was the reason for the visit.

First time going here for my Senior dog. It’s been very hard for me to find a veterinary clinic that I feel comfortable with. Everyone was very friendly here. They treated my dog with much care. I took him to get his eye checked. Vet also did a complete very thorough exam. Vet was very knowledgeable. Clinic was real clean with a great clean smell. I will definitely be going back.

Happy with vet Dr Wright
They called to see how my dog was next day. Very happy
Great facility and great staff!
This clinic is now my go to. Staff are very down to earth and lovely. Thanks!
They are very professional and loving of our pets. They are very reasonable in price.

My dog is terrified of the vet and everyone here is so nice. They take the time to explain things and have been very friendly. They treat my doggo well and would 10/10 recommend. Photo included for dog tax
Compassionate veterinarians and courteous staff! I highly recommend!!
They saved our animals multiple times by staying up to date on the latest protocols for FIP and more.

I was involved in a high speed accident right in front of their clinic and within seconds they were outside trying to free me from my truck. I was panicked, concussed and hurting really bad. They kept me calm and made sure help was on the way even though I think they could have treated me there. Our dogs have been taken care of here and so have I. Many thanks to their staff for their help. There's still good people in this world and they work here.
My cat Lucy, who usually hates everyone she doesn't know, was really chill with the staff after she gave them treats! We are grateful you the care provided here.
Staff is amazing. My girl loved them
Clean and friendly….very thorough and nice! Found us a new doctor.

Knowledgeable  and caring with my doggies, and convenient location from my house.  I like that they explain procedures and answer my questions patiently. A bit expensive, but I'm not suree if that's about the average elsewhere.
Happy with their service as usual for annual shot.
Great vet clinic! Highly recommend for your pet babies!
They always provided the best TLC! They are taking care of my puppy and gave me so much knowledge! They were also quick to get my fur ball in for an appointment.
We moved from the Northeast 1 1/2 years ago and are completely satisfied with GNAH. We are so blessed to have found this group of caring individuals.

I've been to a lot of vets because I've had pets all my life. But Dr. Tagle was the best experience hands-down that I've ever had with a veterinarian. She was so friendly and personable, and she had a perfect way to describe things to me. She seems like she really cares . Thank you so much! Will definitely be back
David, we really appreciate the 5 stars! Thank you for taking the time to rate us :)
Excellent service!

The doctor is so efficient and with a lot patience with my doggie and with me, because I speak a little bit English and she always try lo understand me… She explain very clearly all indications for my dog
Always a good visit, the staff is friendly.

Dr. Travis and his team do such an amazing job with my Dauschunds. They are caring, patient and make me feel that they have true concern for my dogs. We have been with this Vet since the pups were born. I don’t see myself going anywhere else!
Had to bring my dog in for services, everyone was friendly and professional. Would highly recommend
Fast service, good with separating the animals, very friendly staff. And competitive pricing for routine services.
Great place great people.
Quick service and friendly, gave treat to cat!
Tiversa, we really appreciate the 5 stars! Thank you for taking a moment to rate us.
Staff is very friendly and knowledgeable. Been taking my dog here for about a year!
Courteous and caring staff. Great doctor!
Came in to have our boxer treated for cancer. Love the staff and doctor made us and our baby feel at ease.

Thank you for the review, Damani! We appreciate you taking the time to rate your experience with us. If there's anything we could have done to make your visit even better, we'd be happy to hear from you.
My dog has CHF and they have been wonderful with educating me on his care. Very communicative and helpful with prescription refills and follow ups.

I've been coming here for 4 years and they have been very thorough with my dogs, and know how to handle my anxious German Shepard. I can honestly say my experience here has been positive and their care towards my fur babies has been exceptional. Makes vet visits less stressful. They also have a very good front office staff who answer the calls and answer all my questions. The vet assistants are also always very patient with my gazillion questions. It feel confortable to come here and same goes for my dogs.
Great vet. They treat all of my animals with respect and give great care
Very caring staff and doctor was great at explaining everything to me.

Thank you for the review, Ange! We appreciate you taking the time to rate your experience with us. If there's anything we could have done to make your visit even better, we'd be happy to hear from you.
Excellent vet care for my cat! Comprehensive exams and thorough explanation for care decisions. Dr. Ehrlund and her team are great, and they seem very attuned to my pet’s needs
They are so kind to my babies
Professional, clear communication, courteous and caring

These people were very negligent in caring for my fur baby. I took my cat in to get checked due to fluid filling their lungs and they couldn’t provide me with any explanation as to what or why it was being caused and then couldn’t provide any X-ray or ultrasound they did to show what mass was lumped onto my cats heart. Very disappointing and expected more from these people as I’ve been coming here for years.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Nicole!

I decided to try out GNAH due to it's proximity to my home, as well as it was recommended by someone who had a great experience there with their dog. My experience was just okay, however, when I take my animal to a vet and pay over $200 for a wellness exam, I expect things to be 4-5 star.

First, I was told by the tech that I would be given a 10% discount if I wrote an honest review on google. Upon further calling and asking about this I was informed its actually $10 and it would be credited onto my next visit. This is a pretty ironic incentive, if you weren't happy with your experience, why would you go back for the $10?

Next, I decided to do the wellness package for my cat which included a stool sample. I said I would like them to try to get it the day of the exam, however they didn't do it, and I forgot about it until after I left due to discussion etc....however they also never sent me home with any information about collecting and returning the sample, something that I had paid for.

Finally, the tech was great and friendly however, I just wasn't impressed by the vet. They were nice, however I felt like they were not able to offer much advice. My cat was diagnosed with dental disease and I asked, "what do I don if I can't afford the surgery? What will happen?" The vet didn't have anything to say about what people do, or what happens if they can't afford the $2400 surgery.  She just ignored the question and the sentiment of really loving and caring for my pet, but not being able to afford care like that. She also didn't really describe the process and what that would look like. After talking to a friend who has had a cat with dental disease I learned more. I felt like experience was majorly lacking. I understand that experience takes time, however, if the vet didn't know, maybe they could ask a more experienced vet what they would recommend.

I want to give my animals the best care that I can, with the best vets that I can. If I do decide to have the surgery done, I wouldn't feel comfortable doing it at GNWAH based on this experience. Again everything was okay, but nothing I would write home about, or recommend to others. We will be going back to our regular vet at Heritage Oaks Animal Hospital , as it is worth the 45 minute drive.
Thank you for the 5 stars, Betty!
Very friendly and they care very much in what they do

Baby has lost appetite and had some accidents (diarrhea), they checked her, gave us everything we needed including some preventative for a trip we are having. Love their love and care for the animals.

Short wait time (10-15 minutes in the lobby) before being called back to the exam room; thorough exam by Dr. Michelle; decent cost of services provided (nail trim was the least expensive I've come across in a while-- $20); would recommend.
We’ve been taking our babies to Great Northwest for 25 years and absolutely love them!  Their doctors and staff are wonderful!  Many thanks to everyone there :)
Bella is amazing! She. Is kind, informative, and so patient. If I could give 10 stars I would! Great experience!!
Extremely nice and vart well maintained facilities.
The staff here at Great Northwest Animal Hospital were so friendly and helpful. They took amazing care of my baby and would definitely come back!

Found and brought our rescue foster dog here and the staff especially Danielle has been so helpful and kind giving us the info and resources we need to help our girl get better and find her forever home with some recommendations of rescue. We have brought all our dogs here for many years.

They always taken great care of my dogs!
❤️

Great North West Animal Hospital is the best!!  All of the staff are kind and caring and love Lucky.

They also educate you to do what’s best for your pet (Dog in my case) to keep them healthy and happy.

So Lucky, she was a stray a year ago when I found her. They’ve taken care of her ever since.
We would never go anywhere else.
Lucky actually wags her tail & jumps with excitement to come to the vet.

That’s how it should be.
Thank you so much for giving us a 5 Star rating!
Dr. Saunders is the best!! She has treated our puppy with great care, kindness, and is so knowledgeable. When we’ve had questions outside of our appointment she has been quick to get back to her!

Great Northwest has friendly staff and a clean and welcoming environment. This is my dog’s second time coming and she has been treated with such care and patience each time. I also greatly appreciate their transparency when it comes to what they are doing, why, and how much it will be! They also work with you and provide alternatives (if applicable) to best meet your needs. We moved to San Antonio about 2 years ago and have finally found the right Vet for us! Special thanks to Dr. Loretta and Dr. Arroyo for their compassionate care with Halo! <3
Thanks for the 5 stars! We appreciate you taking the time to leave a review.
Very experienced and caring for animals. Would definitely recommend to friends.
We love our Vets at Great Northwest Animal Hospital their amazing Doctors and Staff they always take good care of our Lilly
We always have to most amazing experiences during our visits. Attentive and kind staff. Dr.Michelle and staff have always taken great care of our pups!

Absolutely love this place. They took such great care of my Yorkie when she had surgery and so caring when we lost her a few years later. We have been coming here ever since with our other Yorkie. Everyone is always so attentive and kind.
Great 1st visit with friendly and efficient staff
Came in because we thought our dog had worms, but the vet checked it and advised that it was probably grass. Still going to have lab work done.
Wonderful care by the vet Dr. Saunders and Bella. was very helpful and very knowledgeable about the treatment necessary for our Sadie . They are a great team and the hospital crew is Amazing!
Staff very friendly.  Explained all options for meds and pricing.  Very nice to Daisy and Lily.
Treats our dog like the queen she is.

Staff are kind and helpful. Vet was super careful with our injured kitten’s broken arm. She also allowed us to put our kitten back into a warm sock to keep it calm as she transported it throughout the vet clinic for x-rays. We greatly appreciated her understanding, even if we were being a little  overprotective of this newly-rescued kitten, lol! Thankful for all of GNWAH’s help.This is our second pet that is a client here.
